values: In 30 Seconds, players must describe five words or names on a card to their teammates without saying the actual words, while the team tries to guess as many as possible before time runs out. It is a fast-paced party game focused on quick thinking and communication.

30 Seconds Junior is a fast-paced family word game where players must describe five items on a card within 30 seconds while their teammates try to guess them. Designed for younger players, it focuses on general knowledge suitable for children, encouraging quick thinking and teamwork. The Irish Edition includes locally relevant content tailored for Ireland.
A wine-themed trivia and social party game where players compete and learn interesting wine facts.
Classic economic strategy game where players invest in and merge hotel chains to maximize shareholder value and outmaneuver opponents.
Adventure Time Card Wars: Collector’s Pack
Standalone 2-player card battler based on the Adventure Time series, featuring prebuilt decks (e.g., Princess Bubblegum vs. Lumpy Space Princess) with lane-based combat and creature spells.
Agricola: All Creatures Big and Small
Two-player farming strategy game focused on breeding animals.
Cooperative Lovecraftian adventure game where investigators stop Ancient Ones.
Betrayal at House on the Hill (2nd Edition)
A semi-cooperative horror exploration game where players build a haunted house tile by tile until one player becomes the traitor in a unique scenario.

Betrayal Legacy is a legacy-style haunted house exploration game where players cooperatively build a family history over multiple sessions, making permanent changes to the board, cards, and story as the campaign unfolds.
A trading and hand-management card game where players plant, harvest, and trade beans to earn coins.
Standalone Carcassonne set in the American Old West with gold mining and trading.

Cards Against Humanity is a party game for horrible people. Players complete fill-in-the-blank statements using outrageous, offensive, and dark-humoured answer cards. Designed for adult groups, the game focuses on shock value and comedy, making it popular for parties and informal gatherings.
Common EU Retail RRP (UK Edition, Ireland)
A party game where players complete fill-in-the-blank phrases with humorous responses.
Expansion pack adding 100 new cards to the base Cards Against Humanity party game.

Cards Against Humanity: Second Expansion is an add-on pack for the original Cards Against Humanity game. It introduces additional black and white cards, expanding the humour and variety of combinations. This expansion requires the base game to play.

Cards Against Humanity: Third Expansion is an add-on pack for the original Cards Against Humanity game. It introduces additional white and black cards, expanding the variety of combinations and dark humour possibilities. This expansion requires the base game to play.
Party game where gangsters divide loot using foam guns and bluffing.

Castle Panic is a cooperative tower defense board game where players work together to defend their castle from waves of monsters attacking from the forest. Players trade cards, plan attacks, and coordinate strategies to defeat goblins, orcs, and trolls before the castle walls are destroyed. While cooperative in nature, the player who slays the most monsters can be declared the Master Slayer if the castle survives.
A portable card version of the classic deduction game where players use suggestion and evidence cards to determine the suspect, weapon, and location.
A team-based word association game where players give one-word clues to help teammates guess secret agents while avoiding the assassin.
Cooperative word deduction game for two players where partners give one-word clues to find agents.
Party game combining trivia, wordplay, drawing, sculpting, acting and puzzle challenges. Teams compete across multiple activity categories to reach the finish first.
A Wild West themed social deduction and card game set in Deadwood.

Dixit is a creative storytelling card game where players use imaginative, illustrated cards to give clues and guess which card matches the clue. One player provides a word or phrase inspired by their card, and others submit cards that could fit. Players score points by correctly guessing the storyteller’s card without making it too obvious.

Dobble Animals is a fast-paced observation game where players race to spot the single matching symbol between any two cards. Featuring colourful animal illustrations, it challenges players’ reflexes and visual perception skills. Multiple mini-games are included, making it suitable for families and children.
A fast-paced pattern recognition game for children using matching symbols.

Dobble Kids is a simplified version of the popular Spot It! game, designed specifically for younger players. Players race to spot the single matching symbol between two cards, featuring colourful animal illustrations. It improves observation skills and reaction speed in a fast and engaging format.

Dominion: Intrigue is a standalone expansion to Dominion that introduces new kingdom cards focused on interaction and player choice. Players build their decks by acquiring action, treasure, and victory cards, aiming to create the most efficient engine and score the most victory points by the end of the game.
Typical EU retail (Rio Grande Games edition)
Dungeons & Dragons: Dungeon Master’s Guide (5th Edition)
A core rulebook for D&D 5th Edition providing world-building tools, magic items, optional rules, and guidance for running campaigns as a Dungeon Master.
Introductory D&D 5th Edition boxed set including rulebook, adventure (Dragon of Icespire Peak), dice, DM screen, and character cards. Designed for 2–6 players and beginner-friendly play.
Hasbro EU MSRP / typical EU retail
The core bestiary for D&D 5th Edition, containing hundreds of monsters with full statistics, lore, and encounter guidance for use in fantasy tabletop roleplaying campaigns.
The core rulebook for D&D 5th Edition, providing character creation rules, classes, spells, equipment, and gameplay mechanics for players.
EXIT: The Game – The Forgotten Island

EXIT: The Game – The Forgotten Island is a cooperative escape-room style card game where players solve a series of interconnected riddles and puzzles to escape a mysterious tropical island. Designed as a one-time play experience, players must decode clues, combine items, and think creatively under time pressure to succeed.

Fluxx is a fast-paced card game where the rules constantly change. Players begin with simple rules (draw one, play one), but new rule cards modify how many cards are drawn, played, and how the game is won. The goal keeps shifting throughout the game, making each session unpredictable and different.
A cooperative adventure game where players work together to collect treasures and escape a sinking island before it disappears beneath the waves.
Publisher retail listings (Gamewright / common EU retail)
Cooperative adventure game where players collect treasures before the island sinks.
High-speed Formula 1 and street racing board game featuring custom dice for gear-based movement and risk management. Includes multiple tracks and car types.
A cooperative deck-building adventure game where players explore dungeons, fight monsters, and upgrade abilities to save their village.
Publisher retail listings (Broken Mill / BGG marketplace avg.)
#VALUE! (Function MULTIPLY parameter 1 expects number values. But '€' is a text and cannot be coerced to a number.)
Party game where players hum tunes for teammates to guess; focuses on music knowledge and quick recognition.

ICECOOL is a flicking dexterity game where players control penguins sliding around a 3D cardboard school. One player takes the role of the hall monitor trying to catch the others, while the rest attempt to run through doors to collect fish points without being tagged.
A push-your-luck adventure card game where players explore temples for treasure.

Incohearent: Fresh Phrases Expansion Pack #1 is an add-on pack for the party game Incohearent. Players read nonsense phrases aloud that, when spoken quickly, sound like real words or common expressions. This expansion introduces new phrases to keep the guessing fresh and the party laughter going. Requires the base Incohearent game to play.
Dice-based monster battle game where players compete to control Tokyo.
Word party game where players create categories using spools and then answer them creatively.
Classic code-breaking deduction game where one player creates a secret color code and the other tries to guess it using logic clues.
Monopoly City is a modern edition of Monopoly where players buy property, construct 3D buildings, and compete to bankrupt opponents through rent, development, and tactical city planning.
Typical EU retail (out of print in many regions)
A light card game where players compete to build the most ridiculous team of monster misfits.

Mr. Jack is a two-player deduction game set in Victorian London where one player takes the role of Jack the Ripper and the other plays the detective. The detective must deduce which character is Jack before he escapes, while Jack tries to avoid detection and flee the district.
Victorian-era area control game where players secretly control literary characters, using influence and intrigue to dominate London districts.

Oritama is an abstract strategy game inspired by martial arts duels. Designed for two players, it features elegant, chess-like mechanics where players move pieces according to movement cards that rotate between opponents, creating deep tactical play despite simple rules. Each match is quick but highly strategic, requiring careful planning and anticipation.
A team-based party game where players try to guess items from a top-ten list.
Push-your-luck dice game using pig-shaped dice.

Patchwork is a two-player strategy game where players compete to build the most aesthetically pleasing and high-scoring quilt on a personal board. Players take turns selecting uniquely shaped fabric pieces, managing buttons as currency and time as a resource. Strategic placement and efficient use of space are key to winning.
Lively dice game where players roll custom dice and race to grab matching coloured discs. Fast-paced reflex and pattern recognition family game.
Fast-paced party card game where players race to match category prompts with letter cards, shouting answers quickly to win rounds.
A party game where players complete setup cards with punchlines to create the funniest family scenarios.
Risk is a classic strategy game of global conquest where players command armies, capture territories, and attempt to eliminate opponents through dice-based combat and long-term strategic positioning.

Risk Legacy is a legacy version of the classic global conquest game where players permanently alter the board, rules, and factions over multiple sessions, creating a unique evolving campaign of strategic area control.

Mythological variant of Risk set in an ancient world of gods and monsters. Players battle for earthly domination while also contending in the Underworld, using divine powers and mythic units. Includes 382 figures.

Chess is a classic two-player abstract strategy game played on an 8×8 board. Players move pieces with distinct abilities aiming to checkmate the opponent’s king. It is one of the oldest and most widely played strategy games in the world.
Variant of the classic Scrabble word game that introduces special “trick” cards allowing players to bend or break standard rules for surprise tactical plays.

Scrawl is a party drawing and guessing game where players sketch phrases badly on purpose and pass them around the table, leading to increasingly ridiculous interpretations. Inspired by the telephone game format, drawings and guesses evolve in unexpected and often hilarious ways, making it ideal for larger groups and family gatherings.

Scrawl (Adult Edition) is a mature party drawing and guessing game where players intentionally create terrible drawings that are passed around the table, resulting in increasingly outrageous interpretations. Designed for adult groups, it features risqué and explicit prompts that amplify the chaotic and humorous telephone-style gameplay.
A hidden role deduction game set in 1930s Germany where players work as Liberals or Fascists trying to enact their agenda while identifying (or protecting) Hitler.

In Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective, players work together to solve complex cases in Victorian London by following leads, consulting newspapers, and visiting locations across the city. The goal is to solve the mystery using logic and deduction, ideally with fewer leads than Sherlock himself.
A real-time party game where players secretly signal teammates to guess matching spy cards without getting caught.
A fast-paced dice-driven engine-building game where players draft ships to build a space fleet, earning income on opponents’ turns and upgrading sectors to maximize rewards.
Typical EU retail (base game, standard edition)

Speak Out is a party game where players wear a mouthpiece that holds their lips open while trying to say phrases clearly for their teammates to guess. The distorted speech creates hilarious misunderstandings, making it a lively and fast-paced game for families and parties.

Splendor is a card-driven engine-building game where players act as Renaissance merchants acquiring gem mines, transportation, and artisans to build prestige. Players collect tokens and purchase development cards to gain bonuses and attract nobles. The first player to reach 15 prestige points wins.
A fast-paced deckbuilding card game set in space where players battle using ships and bases to reduce opponents’ authority to zero.
Cooperative narrative-driven scenario game where players act as temporal agents solving missions across different timelines. Modular system with replayable scenarios.

T.I.M.E Stories: The Marcy Case is a narrative scenario expansion set in 1992, where players act as temporal agents investigating a mysterious case involving a young girl with unusual abilities. It focuses on exploration, decision-making, and branching story paths within the T.I.M.E Stories system.
The trivia game for geeks featuring 1,000 questions across geeky categories like sci-fi, gaming, comics, and pop culture. Designed for quick, competitive party play.

The Resistance: Avalon is a hidden identity and deduction game set in the Arthurian legend. Players are divided into Loyal Servants of Arthur and Minions of Mordred, attempting to complete quests or secretly sabotage them. Bluffing, social deduction, and careful discussion determine which team prevails.
The Settlers of Catan: 5–6 Player Extension
Expansion allowing the base game of Catan to be played with up to 6 players; adds extra terrain tiles, resource cards, and components.
Players collect train cards to claim railway routes across a map, completing destination tickets for points in this accessible route-building classic by Alan R. Moon.
A themed edition of Trivial Pursuit based on The Walking Dead TV series.
Party/party question storytelling game – black box with red question-mark design.
A conversation card game designed to spark meaningful questions and deeper connections between players.
Card game set in the Warhammer Old World political landscape.
A hidden identity word deduction game combining social deduction and word guessing.
Real-time cooperative strategy game based on the XCOM video game series; players coordinate global defense against alien invasion using a companion app.

Zombie Kidz Evolution is a cooperative legacy-style game where players work together to defend their school from invading zombies. As players win games, they unlock new envelopes, rules, powers, and challenges, allowing the game to evolve over time. It combines simple mechanics with progressive content, making it ideal for families and younger players.
